name: YUANEANG
summary: Amazon brand selling PLA (standard, matte, silk, crystal, rainbow and multi-colour), PETG, ABS, ASA and TPU, heavily as 10-16 spool bundles at $8-10/kg and as 1 kg spools at about $12-17/kg. The seller is a Dongguan plastics technology company.

product_lines.name: PLA Silk (single, dual, triple colour, rainbow)
PLA Crystal, Rainbow, Matte Rainbow, Dual/Triple-Color

additional_notes: Legal entity: dongguan yuanyang suliao keji youxian gongsi (rendering: Dongguan Yuanyang Plastic Technology Co., Ltd.), Huangjiang Town, Dongguan, Guangdong; Amazon seller 'yuanyangkeji' (id A3FISMRD54LLNX), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads 'YUANENG', which differs from the brand spelling 'YUANEANG'; the deal tracker's group ids also use 'yuaneng'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website was identified. 'suliao keji' means plastic technology, so in-house extrusion is plausible but not shown. First-pass note kept: its silk PLA listings resemble Yousu's, which is resemblance only and no relationship is recorded.

provenance.conflicts: The English company name is a rendering of a pinyin Business Name. Brand spelling YUANEANG vs Manufacturer field YUANENG is unexplained. Whether the plastics company extrudes the filament is unknown.
